title: Organic Farming vs Conventional Farming - the benefits and differences of farming organically
summary: Naturopathic college tours a biodynamic farm, contrasting organic soil-building and pest control with chemical-based conventional farming.

assertions.quote: instead of using chemicals we rely on natural methods like physically removing weeds by hand
with organic farming the long-term health and fertility of the soil is prioritized

verdicts.note: The review states organically managed farms tend to have higher soil organic matter, one component of soil health, cited in passing.

Ponisio's introduction cites studies showing organic outperforms conventional on some, but not all, sustainability metrics, including soil fertility and water infiltration and holding capacity (a literature citation, not new data).

assertions.quote: in organic farming there's also a commitment to sustainability and not harming the environment
the safety assessments are carried out one pesticide at a time
there's no question that they've had a negative impact on human health
yes it might cost a bit more but how we fuel our body is perhaps the most important decision we can make regarding our health
